data_points.notes: SCOPE CAVEAT: covers toothpaste, toothbrushes and accessories, mouthwash/rinses, dental accessories, denture products, dental prosthesis cleaning solutions and other oral care — i.e. wider than a pure BPC oral-care definition (denture/prosthesis cleaning is arguably dental rather than BPC). PUBLISHER-INTERNAL CONFLICT: Renub's own later report page (researchandmarkets.com/reports/6054934) gives USD 1.23bn for 2025, i.e. the same publisher shows a ~40% downward revision one vintage later. Do not average.
